name: Blade Barrier
description: A wall of whirling blades made of magical energy appears — a straight wall up to 100 feet long and 20 feet high, or a ring 60 feet across — granting three-quarters cover and counting as difficult terrain. A creature in the wall when it appears, or that enters it or ends its turn there, makes a Dexterity save, taking 6d10 force damage on a failure or half on a success, once per turn at most.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning arcs to a target you can see, then leaps to up to three other targets within 30 feet of the first. Each target makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d8 lightning damage on a failure or half on a success; each higher-level slot adds one more leaping bolt.

name: Circle of Death
description: Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius sphere from a point you choose. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success; each higher-level slot adds 2d8 damage.

name: Conjure Fey
description: You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in the shape of a Fey creature. When it appears — and as a bonus action on later turns, teleporting it up to 30 feet — you make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it: on a hit the target takes 3d12 + your spellcasting ability modifier psychic damage and has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn. Upcasting adds 2d12 damage.

name: Contingency
description: You prepare for the worst: as part of casting this spell you also cast a spell of 5th level or lower that targets you, and describe a trigger. When the trigger first occurs, the stored spell takes effect on you and the contingency ends. Only one contingency can guard you at a time, and it ends if the gem-encrusted statuette of yourself leaves your person.

name: Create Undead
description: Only at night, you raise up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids as ghouls under your control for 24 hours; recasting reasserts control instead of animating anew. Higher-level slots animate more ghouls, or more powerful undead — ghasts, wights, and even mummies.

name: Disintegrate
description: A thin green ray streaks to a creature, object, or creation of magical force: a creature that fails its Dexterity save takes 10d6 + 40 force damage, and if that drops it to 0 hit points it is disintegrated into gray dust, revivable only by True Resurrection or Wish. Nonmagical objects and force creations of Large size or smaller are destroyed automatically; upcasting adds 3d6 damage.

name: Eyebite
description: Your eyes become inky voids of dread. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns, choose a creature within 60 feet: on a failed Wisdom save it suffers one effect of your choice — Comatose (the Unconscious condition), Panicked (the Frightened condition, forced to flee you), or Sickened (the Poisoned condition).

name: Find the Path
description: You name a location you are familiar with on your plane, and for the duration you always know how far it is, in which direction it lies, and which path is most direct whenever the way forks.

name: Flesh to Stone
description: You try to turn one creature you can see to stone: on a failed Constitution save it gains the Restrained condition as its flesh hardens (on a success its speed is simply 0 until the start of your next turn). It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns — three successes end the spell, three failures leave it Petrified, and if you hold concentration for the full duration the stone lasts until freed by Greater Restoration or similar magic.

name: Forbiddance
description: You ward up to 40,000 square feet against magical travel: teleportation and planar portals fail into the area, and creature types you choose (from Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead) take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) the first time they enter on a turn or when they end their turn there, unless they speak the password you set. Cast daily for 30 days, it lasts until dispelled.

name: Globe of Invulnerability
description: A shimmering, immobile barrier surrounds you in a 10-foot emanation. Spells of 5th level or lower cast from outside simply cannot affect anything within it, and their areas stop at the barrier; each higher-level slot raises the blocked spell level by one.

name: Guards and Wards
description: You ward up to 2,500 square feet of floor space: corridors fill with confusing fog, doors lock as if by Arcane Lock (some hidden behind illusions), and stairs web over. You also plant one extra effect — dancing lights, magic mouths, a Stinking Cloud, a Gust of Wind, or a Suggestion trap — and people you name, or who speak your password, pass unharmed. Cast every day for a year, the ward lasts until dispelled.

name: Harm
description: Virulent disease magic ravages a creature you can see: on a failed Constitution save it takes 14d6 necrotic damage and its hit point maximum is reduced by the same amount (never below 1); on a success it takes half damage and its maximum is untouched.

name: Heal
description: Positive energy washes through a creature you can see, restoring 70 hit points and ending the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on it. Each higher-level slot restores 10 more hit points.

name: Heroes' Feast
description: You conjure a magnificent feast that takes an hour to eat; up to twelve partakers then gain blessings for 24 hours: resistance to poison damage, immunity to the Frightened and Poisoned conditions, and a hit point maximum increased by 2d10, gaining the same number of hit points.

name: Mass Suggestion
description: You suggest a course of activity, in no more than 25 words, to up to twelve creatures that can hear and understand you; it must sound achievable and not obviously harmful. Each target that fails its Wisdom save gains the Charmed condition and pursues the suggestion until it is done or the spell ends; higher-level slots stretch the duration to 10 days, 30 days, or 366 days.

name: Move Earth
description: You slowly reshape dirt, sand, or clay in an area up to 40 feet on a side: raise or lower the ground, dig or fill a trench, erect or flatten a wall, each change taking 10 minutes to settle. Stone and structures are untouched, though buildings may collapse if the earth beneath them shifts badly.

name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
description: A frigid globe explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere: each creature makes a Constitution save, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. It freezes surface water deep enough to trap swimmers in the ice (Restrained until they break free), and you may instead hold the globe as a cool sling bullet that keeps its power for 1 minute. Upcasting adds 1d6 damage.

name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
description: One creature you can see within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or fall into a comic dance. On a failure it gains the Charmed condition for the duration: it must spend all its movement dancing in place, has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws and attack rolls, and attacks against it have advantage — though on each of its turns it can spend its action to collect itself and repeat the save, ending the spell on a success. Even on a successful first save it dances until the end of its next turn, spending all its movement in place.

name: Planar Ally
description: You beseech a god, demon prince, or other cosmic power, which sends a Celestial, Elemental, or Fiend in its service. The creature is under no compulsion: you must bargain and pay for its service (roughly 100 gp per minute of task, 1,000 gp per hour, or 10,000 gp per day), and it departs when the task is done or the agreed time expires.

name: Programmed Illusion
description: You create an illusory scene — an object, creature, or other phenomenon no larger than a 30-foot cube — that lies dormant and invisible until a trigger you define occurs, then performs a scripted routine of sight and sound for up to 5 minutes before going dormant again for 10 minutes.

name: Sunbeam
description: A mote of brilliant sunlight hovers above you as you loose beams of radiance in 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long lines — one when you cast the spell and more as Magic actions while it lasts. Each creature in a line makes a Constitution save, taking 6d8 radiant damage and the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

name: Transport via Plants
description: You link a Large or larger plant beside you to another plant you have seen or touched, anywhere on the same plane. For 1 minute, any creature can step into the first plant and out of the second by spending 5 feet of movement.

name: True Seeing
description: A willing creature you touch sees things as they truly are: it gains Truesight out to 120 feet for the duration, piercing darkness, invisibility, illusions, shapechanging, and the veil of the Ethereal Plane alike.

name: Wall of Ice
description: A wall of ice rises as a dome or in ten 10-foot panels, each with AC 12 and 30 hit points. A creature whose space the wall cuts through is shoved aside and makes a Dexterity save, taking 10d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success; a breached section leaves frigid air that deals 5d6 cold damage on a failed Constitution save to creatures passing through. Upcasting adds 2d6 and 1d6 respectively.

name: Wall of Thorns
description: A wall of tangled, needle-thorned brush blocks sight and passage: creatures in its area when it appears make a Dexterity save, taking 7d8 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success. Forcing through costs 4 feet of movement per foot, and the first time a creature enters the wall or ends its turn there it makes the save again against 7d8 slashing damage. Upcasting adds 1d8 to both.

name: Wind Walk
description: You and up to ten willing creatures dissolve into wisps of cloud: in this form you fly at 300 feet, resist damage from mundane blows, and can take only the Dash action or begin the slow, stunning minute of reverting to flesh — which you can later reverse to take to the sky again.

name: Word of Recall
description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet vanish and reappear at your sanctuary — a place, such as a temple, that you designated by casting this spell there. Without a prepared sanctuary, the spell fails.
